author: Rapozo Family
text: Great Service!! Had a septic issue during the evening and they picked up immediately & scheduled to come the next morning. Arrived during stated time window, even though there was an active snow storm/ice rain falling, and called to confirm their arrival 30min before. An absolute gentleman. Will be using these guys again should I need any septic tank maintenance.

author: Cindy Lanzetta
text: Very good. Pumped all of our 3 septic tanks. Professional, prompt and reasonable.

author: S T
text: Bob came for an emergency septic service. He was super efficient, took his time, and got everything emptied. Very grateful. Thanks Bob!

author: Steven Sollas
text: From the moment I called, Bob was profesional and extremely helpful.  He was at my house and getting to work in just about an hour. This was my first time working with him and he went so far above and beyond what anyone could expect.  I had my septic backing up into my house.  I was in a very tight spot and he made sure we got our septic back, same day and at a very reasonable rate.  Thank you for all your help.  You have a customer for life

author: Jeff Kutno
text: Bob did a great job.  We had a clog and were without bathrooms.  He was able to come on a Sunday and get the clog cleared and tank serviced.  He gave great advice for the future health of our tank and was very professional.  A+, I would highly recommend.
